name: io.github.jhuang-tw/djobs
title: djobs — Shared Project Memory for Coding Agents
description: Shared local repository memory for AI coding agents. Agents should use sync_workspace at the start of repository work to recover prior goals, constraints, progress, failures, Git state, and explicit ownership before rereading the project from scratch.

environmentVariables.name: DJOBS_DB
environmentVariables.description: Optional local SQLite path. When unset, djobs uses ~/.djobs/global.db and initializes it automatically on the first MCP tool call.
